## Quality gates

See the [constitution](../.specify/memory/constitution.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [ ] Unit tests added or updated for the changed code, and `pnpm test` passes (§IV)
- [ ] E2E tests cover every major requirement touched, named `USn FR-xxx`, and `pnpm run test:e2e` passes (§V)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## [Unreleased]` for user-visible changes (§VI)
- [ ] `docs/`, `README.md` and `DEVELOPMENT.md` are updated where affected (§VII–IX)
- [ ] No unjustified complexity, speculative code or duplicated knowledge (§I–III)
